items.title: Localizing compliance at scale: achieving South Korea’s ISMS certification

sentences.en: Localizing compliance at scale: achieving South Korea’s ISMS certification.
sentences.zh: 大规模合规本地化：获得韩国ISMS认证。

sentences.en: For ten days, auditors appointed by the Korea Internet & Security Agency (KISA) sat together with us and worked through 80 controls.
sentences.zh: 在十天的时间里，韩国互联网与安全局（ KISA ）任命的审计师与我们坐在一起，通过了80项控制措施。

sentences.en: That is what it took for a company headquartered in the United States, operating a global network serving Korean users, to be certified in South Korea.
sentences.zh: 这就是一家总部位于美国、为韩国用户提供服务的全球网络的公司在韩国获得认证的原因。

sentences.en: Cloudflare has now obtained South Korea's Information Security Management System (ISMS) certification under the ISMS-P framework .
sentences.zh: Cloudflare现已获得ISMS-P框架下的韩国信息安全管理系统(ISMS)认证。

sentences.en: For customers in Korea, this is more than a compliance checkbox.
sentences.zh: 对于韩国的客户来说，这不仅仅是一个合规复选框。

sentences.en: It is evidence that Cloudflare's security and privacy program has been examined not only for whether our controls exist, but for how they operate in the context of Korean law, the Korean language, and the particular expectations of Korean regulators.
sentences.zh: 有证据表明， Cloudflare的安全和隐私计划不仅检查了我们的控制措施是否存在，还检查了它们在韩国法律、韩国语言以及韩国监管机构特定期望的背景下如何运作。

sentences.en: What a Korean user sees when they sign up The most visible result of this work is the Cloudflare account sign-up page.
sentences.zh: 韩国用户在注册时看到的内容这项工作最明显的结果是Cloudflare帐户注册页面。

sentences.en: In most parts of the world, the line that sits above the sign-up button reads: " By continuing, I agree to Cloudflare's terms, privacy policy, and cookie policy.
sentences.zh: 在世界大部分地区，注册按钮上方的一行写着： “继续操作即表示我同意Cloudflare的条款、隐私政策和Cookie政策。

sentences.en: " A user signing up from South Korea sees something different.
sentences.zh: 「从韩国注册的用户看到了不同的东西。

sentences.en: The Korean experience is triggered by the country selected at sign-up and by IP geolocation from within South Korea, and it breaks the same agreement into four separately labeled items, each marked required or optional, each linking to its full text, with an option to agree to all of them at once: 모두 동의 (Agree to all) [필수] 서비스 약관 ([Required] Terms of Service) [필수] 개인정보 수집 및 이용 ([Required] Collection and use of personal information) [필수] 제한된 범위의 개인정보 해외 이전 ([Required] Transfer of a limited amount of personal information overseas) [선택] 제한된 범위의 개인정보 제3자 제공 ([Optional] Sharing a limited amount of personal information with marketing third parties) The three required items are hard gates.
sentences.zh: 韩国体验由注册时选择的国家/地区和韩国境内的IP地理位置触发，它将同一协议分解为四个单独标记的项目，每个项目标记为必填或可选，每个项目链接到其全文，并可选择一次同意所有项目： 모두 동의 （同意全部） [필수] 서비스 약관 （ [必填]服务条款） [필수] 개인정보 수집 및 이용 （ [必填]收集和使用个人信息） [필수] 제한된 범위의 개인정보 해외 이전 （ [必填]转移有限金额

sentences.en: The sign-up button stays disabled until all three are checked, so there is no path through the form that creates an account without an affirmative action on each one.
sentences.zh: 在选中所有三个按钮之前，注册按钮将保持禁用状态，因此如果没有对每个帐户采取肯定行动，则无法通过表单创建帐户。

sentences.en: The optional item governs marketing permission only, and leaving it unchecked has no effect on the account creation (it merely opts the user out of receiving marketing communications).
sentences.zh: 可选项目仅适用于营销权限，不选中它对帐户创建没有影响（它只是选择用户不接收营销通讯）。

items.title: North Korea prepares to restart propaganda loudspeakers as ties sour with South

sentences.en: North Korea prepares to restart propaganda loudspeakers as ties sour with South.
sentences.zh: 由于与韩国的关系恶化，朝鲜准备重启宣传扬声器。

sentences.en: Kim Yo-jong, sister of Kim Jong-un, issues warning after inspecting border fortifications against backdrop of rising tensions Propaganda loudspeakers aimed at South Korea will be ready to restart within days along the entire border, Kim Yo-jong, the powerful sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, has said amid a worsening of ties between the two countries.
sentences.zh: 朝鲜领导人金正恩(Kim Jong-un)的姐姐金庸(Kim Yo-jong)表示，在紧张局势加剧的背景下，金正恩的妹妹金庸(Kim Yo-jong)在检查边境防御工事后发出警告。针对韩国的宣传扬声器将在几天内在整个边境重新启动。在两国关系恶化的背景下，朝鲜领导人金正恩(Kim Jong-un)的强大姐妹金庸(Kim Yo-jong)表示。

sentences.en: The statement, carried by the state news agency KCNA on Thursday, came a day after she said the loudspeakers would be in operation along the whole border from some time in October.
sentences.zh: 国家通讯社KCNA周四发表的声明是在她表示扬声器将从10月份的某个时候开始在整个边境运行的一天之后发表的。

items.title: Controversial US-backed vaccine trial in African newborns halted

sentences.en: Controversial US-backed vaccine trial in African newborns halted.
sentences.zh: 有争议的美国支持的非洲新生儿疫苗试验停止。

sentences.en: Hepatitis B study in Guinea-Bissau that was to be funded by CDC and that drew global backlash ‘will not move forward’ The US-backed hepatitis B vaccine trial in African newborns that drew global backlash was halted, the lead researcher said on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 这位首席研究员周三表示，几内亚比绍的乙型肝炎研究将由疾病预防控制中心资助，并引起全球强烈反对， “不会向前推进”美国支持的在非洲新生儿中进行的乙型肝炎疫苗试验已经停止。

sentences.en: It was “now clear” that the study “will not move forward in Guinea-Bissau”, Frederik Schaltz-Buchholzer, a Danish researcher, wrote on LinkedIn, adding, “we were not given the necessary governmental approval.” Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 丹麦研究人员弗雷德里克·沙尔茨-布赫霍尔泽（ Frederik Schaltz-Buchholzer ）在LinkedIn上写道， “现在很清楚” ，这项研究“不会在几内亚比绍取得进展” ，并补充说， “我们没有获得必要的政府批准。”继续阅读。

sentences.zh: 新北检方称，来自中国的一名名叫“K”的人支付了五名被告伤害黄义浩，台湾检方指控五名男子密谋将一辆汽车撞向一名嘲笑中国共产党和习近平的喜剧演员。

sentences.en: Taiwan has repeatedly accused China of transnational repression to silence critics on the self-governed island, which Beijing claims as its territory and has vowed to take by force if necessary.

items.title: The bridge to agent-scale Git infrastructure

sentences.en: The bridge to agent-scale Git infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 通往代理规模Git基础设施的桥梁。

sentences.en: Over the past year, while Git traffic grew exponentially, 99.99999% of the Git repositories on GitHub began living in two places at once: our own data centers and Azure.
sentences.zh: 在过去的一年中，虽然Git流量呈指数级增长，但GitHub上99.99999%的Git存储库开始同时存在于两个地方：我们自己的数据中心和Azure。

sentences.en: The rest are among the busiest on the platform, and they re held back by just one thing: a 25ms round trip.
sentences.zh: 其余的都是平台上最繁忙的，他们只受制于一件事：往返25毫秒。

sentences.en: In an earlier blog post , we laid out the two principles behind our next-generation storage architecture: Minimize coordination Decouple storage from compute In this post, we ll look at the immediate bridge between our old design and our new one.
sentences.zh: 在之前的博客文章中，我们阐述了下一代存储架构背后的两个原则：最小化协调将存储与计算分离在这篇文章中，我们将介绍旧设计和新设计之间的直接桥梁。

sentences.en: We ll talk about how a change to the way our quorum serializes writes gets the busiest repositories into Azure, and how that same step opens the door to replicas that keep no persistent state of their own.
sentences.zh: 我们将讨论仲裁序列化写入方式的更改如何将最繁忙的存储库转移到Azure中，以及同一步骤如何为没有持久状态的副本打开大门。

sentences.en: How we got here The timing and shape of the move were driven by the agentic shift: rapidly growing traffic, a hard ceiling on the power capacity of our data centers and the surrounding geographical region, and physical supply chain constraints.
sentences.zh: 我们如何到达这里移动的时机和形状是由代理转变驱动的：快速增长的流量，我们数据中心和周边地理区域的电力容量的硬性上限，以及物理供应链限制。

sentences.en: At the beginning of our migration, the remaining capacity with all possible expansion gave us enough time to migrate safely, but not enough to do it slowly.
sentences.zh: 在迁移开始时，剩余的容量与所有可能的扩展让我们有足够的时间安全迁移，但不足以缓慢迁移。

sentences.en: While we had prototyped new architectural approaches for scaling Git on cloud infrastructure, changing the storage architecture and the hosting platform at the same time, under that growth, carried too much risk.
sentences.zh: 虽然我们已经原型化了新的架构方法，用于在云基础设施上扩展Git ，但在这种增长下，同时改变存储架构和托管平台带来了太大的风险。

sentences.en: Given our scale and how critical the service is to the community, we needed to sequence the work carefully: move the data first, then evolve the architecture once it arrived.
sentences.zh: 鉴于我们的规模以及服务对社区的重要性，我们需要仔细排列工作顺序：首先移动数据，然后在架构到达后对其进行演进。

sentences.en: Git operations are a Tier 0 service: they re a core function of GitHub, and nearly everything in GitHub depends on the repository data.
sentences.zh: Git操作是Tier 0服务：它们是GitHub的核心功能， GitHub中的几乎所有操作都依赖于存储库数据。

sentences.en: That meant the data, services, and every dependency had to move first.
sentences.zh: 这意味着数据、服务和每个依赖关系都必须首先移动。

sentences.en: The first copy of a repository landed in Azure s Central US region in August 2025.
sentences.zh: 存储库的第一个副本于2025年8月登陆Azure的美国中部地区。
